definitions.explanation: The act of putting a product on sale or releasing it to the market for the first time.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいスマートフォンが{来月|らいげつ}{発売|はつばい}される。
examples.english: A new smartphone will be released next month.

examples.japanese: チケットは{明日|あした}{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}です。
{発売|はつばい}{日|び}に{並|なら}んで{買|か}いました。
examples.english: I waited in line and bought it on the release day.

notes:
USAGE: {発売|はつばい} is used for releasing products for sale, especially new products, tickets, or media.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {発売|はつばい}する (to release, to put on sale)
- {発売|はつばい}される (to be released)
- {発売|はつばい}{中|ちゅう} (now on sale)
- {発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし} (sales start)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {発売|はつばい}{日|び} (release date)
- {発売|はつばい}{元|もと} (publisher, distributor)
- {新|しん}{発売|はつばい} (newly released)
- {先行|せんこう}{発売|はつばい} (advance sale)
- {発売|はつばい}{記念|きねん} (release commemoration)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {販売|はんばい} - sales (ongoing selling)
- {発行|はっこう} - publication, issuance
